A1.justification: Both readable, complete 32-page PDFs describe the same AdaND research and include appendices A–G. Pages 2–32 have identical extracted text and rendered pixels; differences are confined to first-page affiliation and version/date text.

before.justification: v1 reports original AdaND benchmark results, ablations and failure-case experiments in Sections 3 and 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original AdaND benchmark results, ablations and failure-case experiments, including their appendix results.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same frozen CLIP classifier, pseudo-label-trained noise detector, adaptive thresholds, queue updates and Gaussian noise injection. The AdaND-plus-Tent adaptation in Appendix E is also unchanged.

E1.justification: The same ZS-NTTA and ZS-OOD tasks and dataset coverage remain, including the main benchmark, NINCO evaluation and corrupted CIFAR/ImageNet evaluations in Appendix E.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain ZS-CLIP, Tent, SoTTA and TPT. Table 13 retains TDA, while Table 5 retains Max-Logit, Energy, MCM, CLIPN and NegLabel; no comparator membership changes.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, dataset pairings, batch sizes, model configurations and testing procedures are unchanged, including the noise-ratio experiments and corruption severity specified in the appendices.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical module ablations, injected-noise and hyperparameter sensitivities, corruption tests, and score-distribution and gradient failure analyses in Section 5.3 and appendices C, E–G.

E5.justification: Both report mean and standard deviation across five random seeds, numbered 0–4, for CIFAR-10/100 in Tables 20–21. Run-count, seed and uncertainty-reporting information is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match, including the appendices. For example, both report AdaND's ImageNet average AccH as 73.09 in Table 3 and average ZS-OOD FPR95 as 16.00 in Table 5.

T1.justification: The formal task definitions, metric formulas and adaptive-threshold objective in Equations (1)–(3) are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about the ZS-NTTA setting, classifier-detector decoupling, handling clean and noisy streams, performance and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: Explanations of noisy-sample gradients and classifier degradation are unchanged. Appendix A.2 retains the same limitations concerning cumulative pseudo-label errors and dependence on CLIP's detection accuracy.

D1.justification: Section 5.1, Appendix D and the reproducibility statement retain identical implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware/software information, pseudocode and code-access information.

R1.justification: The reference list and related-work discussion in Appendix B are identical, including positioning relative to noisy TTA, OOD detection and vision-language models.

P1.justification: Affiliation 1 expands from 'TMLR Group, Hong Kong Baptist University' to 'TMLR Group, Department of Computer Science, Hong Kong Baptist University'. The arXiv version/date stamp also updates. Other prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and their placement are identical. Pages 2–32 render identically, and the first-page text edits preserve the existing layout without reflow.

improvement.justification: v2 adds departmental specificity to an affiliation and updates the arXiv stamp. The methods, evidence, interpretations, limitations and reproducibility information are otherwise identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net difference in paper quality.
